meaning:
νομοθετέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָרָה hi. ;]
1. intrans., to make laws; pass., to be furnished with laws: Heb.7:11.
2. Trans., to ordain by law, enact: pass., Heb.8:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise…
